note: Product specification from the documents: the ethylene product must stay polymer grade (project premise, CET 69 (2018) 703-708). The tower's key separation is ethylene from ethane; the paper measures ethane in the product at 486.7 ppm (Table 1, analyser AI-5417A, April 2015) and the pre-project balance gives 99.942 wt % ethylene. Polymer grade is taken as ethylene at least 99.9 wt %, so ethane in the product at most 0.1 wt % (1,000 ppm). Methane and nitrogen in the product are set by the vent and the pasteurisation trays, which the model represents only through the vent split; they are not part of this spec.
